question: What carbon and nitrogen contents did XPS give for the (Pd/Cu)0.5%C3N4 photocatalyst used for photocatalytic ozonation?
rendered:
According to the document, for the (Pd/Cu)0.5%C3N4 photocatalyst, XPS quantitative analysis results showed that there is an excess quantity of carbon atoms in relation to nitrogen. The theoretical ratio should be equal to 0.75:1 for C3N4, whereas it is approximately 0.9:1 for (Pd/Cu)^0.5%C3N4 samples. This means there is around 15 at.% adventitious carbon within the total carbon quantity present on the sample surface. 

The XPS quantitative analysis results for the (Pd/Cu)0.5%C3N4 photocatalyst are as follows:
Catalyst O [at. %] C [at. %] N [at. %] Pd [at. %] Cu [at. %] Pd:Cu
(Pd/Cu)^0.5%C3N4 5.20 43.83 50.06 0.68 0.23 3.0
